description.text:
Brilliant Illusions (璀璨诡幻) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 13 March 2026 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. Milotic, called the most beautiful Pokémon, is on its cover: it evolves from Feebas, and its rainbow-colored scales are said to change color with the angle they are seen from. With it come the Pokémon of Kitakami, Ogerpon, Okidogi, Munkidori, Fezandipiti and Pecharunt, who share an untold story, all as Pokémon ex. Ogerpon's form, type and Ability change with the mask it wears, and the set has four Ogerpon ex, in the Teal, Hearthflame, Wellspring and Cornerstone Masks; the Item Ogre's Mask switches between them. Trainers from Kitakami, among them Kieran and Carmine, appear as Supporters, and its new ACE SPEC cards include Secret Box, Scoop Up Cyclone, Neutralization Zone and Legacy Energy.

The Brilliant Illusions coin set (璀璨诡幻硬币套装) came out the same day: three 5-card packs, one of 30 chosen holos (five Pokémon ex and 25 Common, Uncommon or Rare Pokémon, in Poké Ball pattern or, one time in a hundred, Master Ball pattern) and a coin of that Pokémon in one of two regular styles or a rare gold one. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. Its main cards are numbered out of 207; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 264.
